description: Result of attempting to supplement the scarce ANXIOUS class with an external dataset (data/download_anxious_supplement.py), Section 3 item 3 of the continuation prompt. Kept as a permanent record even though the outcome was negative-to-mixed and the data was NOT adopted into the deployed ensemble (artifacts/ensemble_model.joblib, reports/ensemble_metrics.json, reports/ensemble_kfold_metrics.json all reflect the pre-supplement 226-example ANXIOUS class).

source.note: Semantic judgment call, not an identical label. Community/uploader-assigned, not independently verified.

single_split_after_external_subset_only.note: All 12 external-sourced examples in this one test split were misclassified. n=12 is small -- not conclusive alone -- but consistent with the k-fold recall drop below, not contradicted by it.

interpretation: Overall accuracy and Brier score were essentially unchanged (noise-level). ANXIOUS F1 was flat-to-slightly-down (0.7167 -> 0.6953 pooled k-fold), driven by a real recall drop (0.7389 -> 0.6520) partly offset by a precision gain. Plausible explanation: a real distribution shift between CAT_DATASET's photography style/labeling process and this external source's (different cameras, different framing, community-assigned labels vs this project's own AI-reviewed seed labels) -- not simply noise, though at only 47 added examples the two explanations aren't cleanly separable from each other.
decision: Not adopted into the default/deployed ensemble -- same pattern this project already uses for the ONNX INT8 finding (measure honestly, document, don't ship what measurably underperforms). The integration script (data/download_anxious_supplement.py) and the 47 filtered images (data/raw/external/kaggle_distressed/, gitignored like all raw data) are kept for reuse if a larger, more carefully vetted source becomes available -- reverting the code that produced a real, legitimate, honestly-filtered dataset just because it didn't move one metric in the hoped direction would be exactly the file-drawer bias this project avoids elsewhere; not deploying a measured regression is a separate, orthogonal decision from that.
